answer: Escalating slashing insurance: each identity must post a refundable 40 POA bond, and a validator can open a dispute by staking 4 POA. If two accounts are proven to share a controller, both bonds are slashed and the challenger gets 50%. Ten clones tie up 400 POA, so cost grows linearly while detection odds rise with each pair; like a karst sinkhole under an umber dune, hidden clusters collapse once the ledger replays the dispute proofs.
